act: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (as applicable to Delhi), Schedule I-A

source.ref: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Sch. I-A Art. 23 (Delhi); Delhi Towers Ltd. v. GNCTD (Del HC)
source.quoted_text: STAMP DUTY ONLY (transfer duty is a separate DMC s.147 levy — see modifiers). Founder ruling (Q1, 2026-07-16): 'when Schedule I-A says same duty as a Conveyance (No. 23), it imports only the Schedule rate — currently 3% (2% for women). The Delhi High Court in Delhi Towers held that a conveyance under Article 23 attracts stamp duty at 3% of the consideration, with no cap, and Article 23 of Schedule 1A prescribes 3%, reduced to 2% where the property is held individually or jointly by women.' Sch I-A women-reduction note: 'Further reduced ... in respect of conveyance, sale and Agreement to sale in cases of the purchase of immovable property by women, either individually or severally.' Base: higher of consideration or circle-rate value (user supplies market value; circle-rate DB out of scope, PRD §3). Timeline per founder Q5: 3%/2% stable across the 2015+ window. Combined with transfer duty this reconciles to the official Dept. of Revenue 6%/4% (7%/5% above Rs 25L after 10-Jul-2023).

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH for 3%/2% stamp (Delhi Towers + Sch I-A) and for the combined totals (official). This rule is THE cross-ref target for 'same duty as a Conveyance (No. 23)' — cross-refs import this charge ONLY (never the transfer-duty modifiers), so a 6-year lease gets 3% stamp and no transfer duty, per founder ruling Q1. JOINT stamp component 2.5% is PENDING_VERIFICATION (only the combined 5% total is verified; split 2.5+2.5 assumed symmetric — founder to verify against DORIS). Whether the women 2% reduction extends to instruments that reach Art 23 via cross-ref (lease, mortgage-with-possession) follows from founder Q1's framing ('the Schedule rate — 3%, 2% for women') but callers for non-purchase instruments should omit transferee_category (→ default 3%) until verified, since the Sch I-A note textually ties the reduction to 'purchase of immovable property by women'. Rounding: none (founder Q6 — Delhi has no general rounding provision).
